verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud docs describe finding and optimizing resource-heavy queries and tuning workload performance around RU consumption. That glancingly covers the slow-query and performance-metrics parts of the story, but there is no explicit evidence of a built-in insights view. missing for 10: a documented built-in insights view, index recommendations, a slow-query/statement listing UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view

citations.quote: Diagnose and optimize your resource consumption explains how to find and optimize queries and processes that may be consuming excessive resources.
This page describes how to understand your CockroachDB Standard cluster's Request Unit (RU) consumption and tune your workload to balance performance and costs.
